title: Eleven Names on a Piece of Paper
subtitle: 信念信仰 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 信念信仰（做人与做事·信念与信任）
meta: 主题语境：信念信仰（做人与做事·信念与信任）　|　核心词汇：trust　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trust 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother's ① trust was not in God, which surprised everybody, and not in the bank, which surprised nobody; it was in eleven people, and she could name them, and she did, every year, on the same day. She ② trusted the post office and nothing else that had a counter, and she said the difference between trust and hope is that trust has a name on it.

In 1961 she ③ put her trust in a man who was not one of the eleven, and he took four hundred pounds, and she never said a word about it, not for thirty-one years. She had ④ taken him on trust because he had been introduced at the chapel, and she said afterwards that the chapel had not introduced him, a man had, and that she had heard what she wanted to hear.

The ⑤ trust fund, meaning the money my great-grandfather had left in 1931, was eleven hundred pounds and was held by the county until 1974, and then it was gone, and nobody could say where. It had been ⑥ in trust, which my father said meant it belonged to nobody and therefore to somebody, and my grandmother said it meant it belonged to the county, and she was right again.

In 1989 she ⑦ trusted me with the keys to the house; I was thirty-one and had never asked for them. She said a person you can trust with keys is not necessarily a person you can trust with anything else. For eleven years after that she ⑧ trusted to luck over the roof, my father said, and the roof held until 1998, and then it did not.

The ⑨ trust she left behind, and there was some, was not money but eleven names on a piece of paper, in the drawer with the bills, and I found it in 2003. I ⑩ trust the list because she wrote it, and I do not trust myself to add to it, and I have not added a name in twenty years.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 信托；托管（财产）
D. v. 托付；交托（trust sb with sth）
E. 固定搭配：put one's trust in ... 信任……；把信任交给……
F. 固定搭配：take ... on trust 凭信任接受；不加置疑地相信
G. 固定搭配：trust fund 信托基金
H. 固定搭配：trust to luck / chance 听天由命；碰运气

items.q: My grandmother's trust was not in God
She trusted the post office and nothing else
she put her trust in a man
She had taken him on trust
The trust fund, meaning the money
she trusted me with the keys
she trusted to luck over the roof
I trust the list because she wrote it

answers.why: trust 意为“信任、信赖”，祖母的信任不在上帝那里，也不在银行，而在十一个人身上。
trusted 是动词，意为“信任、信赖”，她只信任邮局，其他有柜台的机构一概不信。
put one's trust in ... 意为“把信任交给……、信任……”，1961 年她把信任交给了一个不在那十一人之列的人。
take ... on trust 意为“凭信任接受、不加置疑地相信”，她凭教会里的一次介绍就相信了他。
trust fund 意为“信托基金”，指曾祖父 1931 年留下的一千一百英镑。
in trust 意为“（财产）受托代管、信托”，那笔钱一直由郡里托管。
trust sb with sth 意为“把某物托付给某人”，1989 年她把房子的钥匙交托给我。
trust to luck 意为“听天由命、碰运气”，此后十一年她对屋顶的事一直听天由命。
the trust 意为“信任”，她留下的信任不是钱，而是纸上的十一个名字。
trust 是动词，意为“信任、信赖”，我信任这份名单，因为那是她写的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 祖母的信任不在上帝那里，而在十一个她能叫出名字的人身上。（trust）
她只信任邮局，其他有柜台的机构一概不信。（trust）
1961 年她把信任交给了一个外人，他拿走了四百英镑。（put one's trust in）
她凭教会里的一次介绍就相信了他，后来承认是听到了自己想听的话。（take ... on trust）
那笔钱一直由郡里托管，1974 年就不见了。（in trust）
1989 年她把房子的钥匙交托给我，而我从未开口要过。（trust sb with）
answers: My grandmother's trust was not in God but in eleven people she could name.
She trusted the post office and nothing else that had a counter.
In 1961 she put her trust in a man from outside, and he took four hundred pounds.
She had taken him on trust because he had been introduced at the chapel, and she admitted she had heard what she wanted to hear.
The money had been in trust with the county, and in 1974 it was gone.
In 1989 she trusted me with the keys to the house, and I had never asked for them.

answers: My grandmother's trust was not in God and not in the bank but in eleven people, and she said the difference between trust and hope is that trust has a name on it.
She trusted the post office and nothing else that had a counter.
In 1961 she put her trust in a man who was not one of the eleven, and she had taken him on trust because he had been introduced at the chapel.
